description: Optional OpenTelemetry metrics of a Club Calendar instance. Assumes a Prometheus-compatible datasource fed via the standard OTLP to Prometheus name translation: dots become underscores, counters get the suffix _total, curly-brace units such as {login} are not appended, boolean attributes appear as the strings "true"/"false". Counters are exported as deltas, so the OTel Collector must run the deltatocumulative processor. Gauges are reported hourly (queried with a 2h lookback) or daily (26h lookback) to bridge Prometheus staleness. The metric club_calendar_club_members holds both the hourly role totals (no stat label) and the daily per-club distribution (stat label); queries separate them by the stat label.

panels.title: Users
panels.description: Registered users (verified and unverified). Reported hourly.

panels.title: Clubs
panels.description: Reported hourly.

panels.title: Calendars
panels.description: Non-archived calendars. Reported hourly.

panels.title: Events
panels.description: Published events (drafts excluded). Reported hourly.

panels.title: Feeds
panels.description: Calendar feeds of all visibilities. Reported hourly.

panels.title: Personal subscriptions
panels.description: Members with a personal subscription (My subscription). Reported hourly.

panels.title: MCP clients
panels.description: Registered OAuth clients of connected AI apps. Reported hourly.

panels.title: MCP grants
panels.description: Active (not revoked) connections of AI apps to user accounts. Reported hourly.

panels.title: Memberships by role
panels.description: Club memberships per role (member, viewer, editor, admin), stacked. Reported hourly. The distribution series of the same metric family carry a stat label and are excluded.

panels.title: Users by verification
panels.description: Verified vs. unverified accounts. Unverified accounts are removed after 30 days. Reported hourly.

panels.title: Members per club (all roles)
panels.description: Distribution over clubs of the total member count (avg, min, max, median, population stddev). Updated once a day, so the line is a step per day.

panels.title: Calendars per club
panels.description: Distribution of non-archived calendars per club. Updated once a day.

panels.title: Events per calendar
panels.description: Distribution of events (drafts included) per calendar. Updated once a day.

panels.title: Members per club by role (latest)
panels.description: Distribution of member counts per club, one row per role and one column per statistic. Latest daily report.

panels.title: Feeds by visibility
panels.description: Number of feeds per visibility (public, club, private). Reported hourly.

panels.title: Feeds per club and calendars per feed
panels.description: Distributions over clubs (feeds per club) and over feeds (calendars per feed). Updated once a day.

panels.title: Feed requests by visibility
panels.description: Served requests per interval. Mostly calendar apps polling in the background, not people. Only counted after access was granted. my_subscription = personal subscription feed.

panels.title: Feed requests by kind
panels.description: ics = calendar subscription, web = public web view, event = event detail, event_ics = single-event download.

panels.title: Feed requests: 200 vs 304
panels.description: 304 = unchanged, answered by revalidation without a body. A high 304 share means clients poll efficiently.

panels.title: 304 share
panels.description: Share of feed requests answered with 304 (not modified) in the selected time range.

panels.title: Feed requests (range)
panels.description: Total served feed requests in the selected time range.

panels.title: Successful vs. failed sign-ins
panels.description: Every evaluated attempt counts. A password sign-in with MFA counts once at the primary stage and once at the mfa stage.

panels.title: Sign-ins by method
panels.description: password, passkey, sso (any provider), totp and backup_code (MFA stage). Successes and failures together.

panels.title: Sign-ins by stage
panels.description: primary = first factor or SSO/passkey, mfa = second factor. MFA counts only at its own stage.

panels.title: Failure ratio (primary)
panels.description: Failed share of primary-stage attempts in the selected range. Includes mistyped passwords and probing.

panels.title: Failure ratio (MFA)
panels.description: Failed share of MFA-stage attempts in the selected range.

panels.title: MCP calls by access
panels.description: read vs. write tool calls per interval (access = scope the tool asked for; unknown if none).

panels.title: MCP calls by outcome
panels.description: ok vs. error.

panels.title: Top 10 tools
panels.description: Most called MCP tools in the selected time range.

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Share of MCP tool calls that ended in an error in the selected range. Includes expected refusals such as missing permissions.

panels.title: MCP calls (range)
panels.description: Total tool calls in the selected range.
